Verses.26: For you are all children of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
Verses.27: For all of you who were baptized into Christ, you have clothed yourselves with Christ.
Verses.28: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free, this is neither male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.
Verses.29: If you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham's descendants. Then you are heirs according to the promise.

Changes: 2025-02-03 - Paul Prins: First translation of verses 26-29 based on Greek.
